gen-dafont-bloody-gf-roboto: Bloody swaggers in with fat, rounded lowercase and a commanding, bloody attitude. Roboto keeps its round letters generously open and its lowercase close to capital height, so a sans-serif body reads smoothly down a full page.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-ruda: Fat, round-bellied lowercase gives Bloody a commanding, bloody menace that is hard to ignore. Ruda does the quieter job, a wire-like monoline sans with a sizable x-height that suits screen reading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-saira: Saira, plain sans through and through, stretches its rounded letters toward the top line and keeps a visible gap in each s. Bloody commands attention; Saira does the quiet, clean reading.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sarpanch: Swollen, round lowercase and a commanding, bloody attitude make Bloody impossible to miss. Sarpanch steps in as the sans-serif body, its lowercase e clearly open and its proportions compact, keeping things grounded.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-savate: Bloody lays down a commanding, bloody swagger through fat, rounded lowercase forms. Savate keeps sturdy hairlines and open jaws on every curve, so the sans-serif body stays crisp beside it.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Round, swollen lowercase gives Bloody a commanding, bloody presence that fills the room. Schibsted Grotesk then steps back, its e and a looking open and its terminals never closing in.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sen: Sen moves along in a modern, constant-weight line, its curved strokes stopping short before they turn inward. But the real hook is Bloody's commanding, bloody roundness set against Sen's marker-nib line.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sintony: Loud and round: Bloody commands the top while Sintony holds a chunky midzone and smooth curves underneath. Sintony's sans letters never clog, so a full page of text flows smoothly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans draws every glyph with an unmodulated line, its rounded letters clearly open on one side. Bloody supplies the commanding swagger while the sans keeps the page steady.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Clean, constant strokes in Sofia Sans Semi Condensed sit under Bloody's commanding, round-lowercase swagger. And with lowercase close to capital height and visible entrances into each curve, text keeps moving steadily.
